description: PocketLedger is a personal finance app, expense tracker, spending tracker, and budget tracker inside ChatGPT. Log expenses by chatting, track spending, search your transaction history, spot possible duplicate charges, and get clear spending reports, category reports, financial reports, and monthly budget summaries. It helps with expense management, money management, budget management, and everyday personal finance without spreadsheets or a separate finance app.

defaultPrompt: I just bought a coffee from Starbucks for $8.
Show my spending by category this month.
